verdict: Leads held steady at a solid cost; spend efficiency is being tightened now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 130 leads from Meta at $11.02 per lead — a consistent result. This past week, ad spend increased 6.59% but lead volume did not move with it, which means the higher budget is not yet buying additional leads; we're reviewing the campaign to close that gap before scaling further. Separately, search clicks dropped sharply week-over-week, making organic search a weaker discovery path than it was — this is being addressed. Your CRM shows 104 of those 130 leads entered the pipeline, and zero appointments won to date; bridging that gap is the near-term priority on the intake side. Next period, expect tighter spend efficiency and pipeline follow-up steps to come into focus as August milestones complete.
